General Guidelines
People come to Yelp to connect with great local businesses. We know that people won’t always agree, but we expect everyone on the site to treat one another and the platform with honesty and respect. We’ve put together these general guidelines to help set the tone for discourse on the site—just in case. Please also read the additional guidelines below for specific types of content that you might contribute to the site.
Relevance
: Please make sure your contributions are appropriate to the forum. For example, reviews aren’t the place for rants about political ideologies, a business’s employment practices, extraordinary circumstances, or other matters that don’t address the core of the consumer experience.
Inappropriate content
: Colorful language and imagery are fine, but there’s no place for threats, harassment, lewdness, hate speech, or other displays of bigotry.
Conflicts of interest
: Your contributions to Yelp should be unbiased and objective. For example, you shouldn’t write reviews of your own business or employer, your friends’ or relatives’ business, your peers or competitors in your industry, or businesses in your networking group.
Businesses should never ask customers to write reviews.
Privacy
: Don’t publicize people’s private information. For instance, please don’t post close-up photos or videos of other patrons without their permission, and don’t post other people’s full names unless you’re referring to someone who is commonly referred to by their full name.
Promotional content
: Don’t post promotional material unless it’s in connection with a Yelp advertising product and through a Business Account. Let’s keep the site useful for consumers and not overrun with commercial noise from every user.
Post your own content
: Don’t swipe content from other sites, users, or businesses. Write your own copy and only share your own photos and videos. This also means you shouldn’t use chatbots or other AI tools to create reviews, including using such tools to draft or revise.

Yelp releases new AI-powered discovery and connection features | Yelp - Official Blog Skip to main content Toggle site navigation Yelp - Official Blog Blog News Businesses Community Life at Yelp Yelp.com Yelp for Business Search Yelp News Yelp releases new AI-powered discovery and connection features Yelp’s end-of-year release rolls out new AI-powered Review Insights, enhancements to business discovery, and updates for more seamless connections with service pros, plus AI-enhanced ad optimization for business owners Craig Saldanha Chief Product Officer December 10, 2024 Share This In this end-of-year release we’re introducing: Review Insights that leverage LLMs to surface reviewers’ sentiment on common aspects of a business, offering a shortcut to the information in reviews you care about most. Enhanced business discovery with more personalized content on the home feed and trending searches, as well as refreshed business pages that now surface reviewers’ Recognitions alongside their reviews, display the business’s tipping policies, provide easier ways to quickly connect with businesses, and more. More functionality and availability for Yelp Assistant, our AI chatbot that connects you with pros, along with easy project editing and broadcasting to streamline communication with pros. Request a Quote in Apple Maps, enabling seamless connections with local pros no matter where you’re searching from. AI-powered smart selection for advertisers, which automatically optimizes and strengthens ad performance, and a refreshed AI-enhanced business owner inbox to help service pros better manage their leads. This year, Yelp celebrated 20 years ! From our first review to hundreds of millions of contributions, we’ve grown with our community, always keeping the same mission in mind: helping you connect with great local businesses, whether it’s discovering your new favorite restaurant or finding a service pro who can quickly handle an emergency fix in your home. Today, we’re excited to unveil our end-of-year product release, featuring more than 20 new features and updates designed to enhance the Yelp experience for both consumers and business owners. This release includes new AI-powered Review Insights to help you seamlessly find the right business for your needs, a more personalized home feed to help you discover new local gems, more information on a business’s tipping policies so you know what to expect before you get there, enhancements to Yelp Assistant to simplify how you find the right service pro for your project, and more. For business owners, we’re excited to introduce AI-powered features that automatically optimize ads and simplify lead management—helping them attract more high-intent customers and streamline their operations. Introducing AI-powered Review Insights: Your shortcut to the information you care about most When searching for a local restaurant, you might have a specific aspect in mind that matters most to you—be it the vibe of the space, how long it takes to get a table, or the quality of the food. While Yelp is known for aggregating consumer reviews of local businesses into a single business rating, we know finding detailed information about your specific interests can be time-consuming. To streamline this process, we’re introducing Review Insights, which leverage large language models (LLMs) to discern reviewer sentiment for common aspects of a business, such as the quality of its food, service, ambiance, wait time, and drinks. Even when a review doesn’t explicitly mention one of the topics, the LLM understands the context in the review to identify and surface the relevant topic and sentiment. Review insights are surfaced as aggregated sentiment scores—positive, neutral, and critical—ranging from 1 to 100 for each topic, conveniently displayed above reviews on business pages. By tapping on these scores, you can delve into all the reviews related to a specific topic you care about, gaining a clearer picture of the firsthand experiences. Currently available on iOS for restaurant, food, and nightlife businesses, we plan to expand Review Insights to services categories next year. AI-enhanced business discovery with more contextual information We’re introducing improved ways to discover, learn about, and connect with local businesses with new features across the home feed and business pages on Yelp. More personalized content on the home feed and trending searches make discovery easier. Plus, we’re continuing to test AI-stitched videos , which use real photos, videos, and information from Yelp, to create unique and engaging videos about local restaurants, showcasing what it’s like to visit the business, its most popular dishes, and more. Business pages will also now surface reviewers’ Recognitions alongside their reviews, display information on the business’s tipping policies, and provide quicker ways to connect with businesses. AI-powered personalized home feed and trending searches inspire new discoveries Your home feed is more dynamic and personalized than ever, featuring a variety of new content types on iOS. The home feed now features: autoplay user videos that unmute and expand to full-screen; user reviews and photos with reviews that surface recent experiences; trending searches to inspire exploration; hot & new and trending businesses to highlight popular spots nearby; videos and collections of businesses featured in Yelp’s top lists, and more. In the coming weeks, we’ll roll out an AI-powered update that better tailors the home feed to your preferences, helping you discover new and relevant businesses.  You’ll also now find trending searches drop down when you begin your search on Yelp’ s iOS app. This search enhancement identifies and generates popular user searches in your area, helping you discover even more great local businesses— coming to Android early next year. More Recognitions in more places To further distinguish contributors who are familiar with specific types of businesses, we’re now showcasing a reviewer’s Recognitions alongside their reviews on business pages. This makes it easy to navigate differing perspectives in reviews and identify reviewers who have experience with businesses in that category. You can also click on the reviewer’s Recognition to explore other businesses they’ve reviewed in the category for additional recommendations.  Initially released for restaurants, food, and nightlife categories earlier this year, Recognitions now highlight even more categories reviewers are passionate about across more than 220 additional home services, beauty, and active life categories. There are now more than 170 Recognitions available when reviewers contribute at least three reviews within a year for businesses within the same select category. In addition to iOS, Recognitions are now available on desktop and coming to Android early next year. Tipping and payment business attributes help you know what to expect before you go To help you better plan for the bill before you get there, we’re add ing eight n ew business attributes that provide more transparency around a restaurant’s tipping policies , as well as payment policies and available payment methods. New attributes include: Whether the business has a “no tipping” policy, if tipping is optional, or if gratuity is automatically applied to the bill, for restaurant, food, nightlife, and beauty services businesses. If tipping is mandatory or optional for large parties for restaurant, food, nightlife, and event services businesses. If the business has credit card processing fees or minimum card payment amounts.  If the business accepts alternative payment methods, including Zelle, PayPal, Venmo, and Cash App.  You can find these attributes under the “Payments” section within the business’s amenities on their Yelp page. Business owners can add these attributes for free by logging into their Yelp for Business account and editing their “Business Information” section. We’re also surveying consumers about these attributes through the “Update the community” questions on Yelp business pages to source the most updated information about a business. Redesigning Yelp business pages for more seamless connections New updates across business pages make it even easier for you to find what you’re looking for and connect with great local businesses. A new “People also search for” section leverages AI to show relevant search recommendations based on your search intent i n select categories, giving you more options to find the right business for your needs—now available on desktop, with iOS coming next month . The new personalized action panel for restaurant, food, and nightlife businesses in the mobile app streamlines your ability to quickly connect with businesses no matter where you scroll on the page—from placing a food order, calling, visiting the website, and more. We expanded our navigation bar feature to all categories on Yelp, letting you jump directly to a business’s amenities, reviews, and more on iOS and Android. Plus, the enhanced business page design on iOS improves readability for frictionless browsing, highlights more relevant information, and simplifies how you find the right business for your needs. Discover and connect with local businesses effortlessly with Yelp’s new features: personalized home feed with more relevant content, Recognitions appearing alongside user profiles, new tipping attributes, and a redesigned business pages showcasing popular searches. Yelp Assistant updates and AI-integrated lead management refine the services experience We’re leveraging AI to enhance the services experience and simplify connections between you and service pros. Yelp Assistant now offers even more functionality and availability—enabling quote requests via texts and calls after you submit a projec t, introducing new conversational prompts in search, and expanding platform availability. Additionally, new updates to the project submission experience make it easy to edit and auto-relay r evised project details with multiple services pros at once for the most accurate quotes. Plus, a new integration in Apple Maps helps you conveniently connect with pros and request a quote no matter where you’re searching from. For business owners, a redesigned inbox with AI-enhanced job summaries surfaces the most relevant information. Enhancing Yelp Assistant and streamlining pro communication with project editing and broadcasting Earlier this year, we introduced Yelp Assistant , a conversational AI feature that intelligently guides you through the process of finding the right service pro to complete your projects. Yelp Assistant now supports requests for texts and calls from service pros after you submit a project on iOS, helping to reduce any friction involved in connecting and coordinating with pros, while masking your phone number for privacy. You can also now find Yelp Assistant through new conversational prompts on search results pages on iOS in addition to the Projects tab across all platforms. We’ll be bringing Yelp Assistant text and calling support and conversational prompts in search to Android and desktop early next year. After submitting your project, we’re making it easier to update your quote submission with project editing and broadcasting—enabling you to add photos, edit details, and attach additional information to your project at any time to provide a clear and more accurate description of your needs. Once you make changes, we’ll notify all the service professionals that received your initial request so they can update their quotes accordingly. This update is currently available on iOS with desktop and Android coming next year. Request a Quote integration on Apple Maps enables seamless connections with local pros To make it even easier to connect with pros, no matter where you’re searching from, our Request a Quote feature is now integrated into Apple Maps. You can effortlessly request quotes from pros across more than 200 home, local, auto, professional, and events categories by clicking the “Quote” button on Apple Maps business pages, which brings you directly into the Request a Quote flow for that business in the iOS Yelp app. For those without the Yelp app installed, the feature directs you to the Request a Quote mobile web experience, ensuring a seamless connection with local pros. This integration brings even more high-intent leads to businesses from people starting their search off Yelp. AI-enhanced business owner inbox helps service pros better manage their leads Keeping track of leads and managing customer communications can be a challenge for local service pros. To simplify this, in the coming weeks, the business owner inbox will be redesigned to surface brief AI-powered summaries with crucial information about the job, allowing service pros to easily evaluate leads at a glance. By leveraging LLMs, we extract and highlight the most relevant information about a job, such as the location, project specifics, whether it’s a one-time job or regular service, and more. Seamlessly connect with service pros to complete your projects with new enhancements to Yelp Assistant and easy project editing and broadcasting, request quotes via Apple Maps, and business owners can benefit from a redesigned inbox that leverages AI to surface the most important information in leads. Harnessing AI to make ad set-up and optimization easier than ever We’re enhancing our product suite for businesses with new features designed to empower local business owners by simplifying ad setup and strengthening ad performance from day one. From AI-enhanced ad optimization to customizable competitive analytics and more options for support, we are committed to providing tools that help business owners achieve their advertising goals with ease. Smart selection leverages AI to optimize Yelp ads and strengthen performance Testing different ads to determine what resonates best with consumers can be time-consuming and require marketing expertise. To simplify this process, we’re introducing smart selection, an AI-powered feature for advertisers that automatically tests the best reviews and photos to showcase, optimizing their ad for the highest return on ad spend. When advertisers select “smart selection” during ad setup, Yelp will select, test, and optimize an ideal review and photo to help maximize the number of users it drives to their Yelp page, increasing their reach, and helping them meet their advertising goals. This free feature is available to all advertisers. Unlocking competitive insights and enhancing support We’re adding new options for competitive insights and support for local businesses with new features designed to simplify their advertising choices. Business owners looking to better understand how their page performance compares to others now have access to more customizable competitive data. The new page views dashboard in their business owner account enables them to compare their page views with up to three competitors of their choice in one view, helping to inform their own growth strategies. For advertisers who see significant fluctuations in their business due to seasonality, we’re introducing new ad budget options that allow them to temporarily reduce their ad spend during seasonal shifts with automatic restarts whenever it’s most convenient for them. Finally, our redesigned Support Center now features refreshed content tailored to businesses’ advertising status, simplifying how they find answers to their questions, underscoring our commitment to supporting business success with helpful resources. Advertisers can maximize their impact with the new AI-powered smart selection, which automatically recommends optimal photos and review text for Yelp ads, while business owners gain new insights by comparing their page visits against competitors of their choice. For two decades, Yelp has consistently elevated how you discover your next favorite spot or new go-to pro, building a vibrant community of locals supporting locals. From business summaries to Yelp Assistant , and now Review Insights, this year, we’ve introduced over 80 new features and harnessed the power of AI to transform the way you discover and connect with local businesses and service pros. Despite how far we’ve come, each exciting new innovation makes us feel like we’re just getting started and we can’t wait to show you what next year will bring. Yelp survey findings reveal consumers favor detailed, genuine reviews over AI-generated or biased content | Yelp - Official Blog Skip to main content Toggle site navigation Yelp - Official Blog Blog News Businesses Community Life at Yelp Yelp.com Yelp for Business Search Yelp News Yelp survey findings reveal consumers favor detailed, genuine reviews over AI-generated or biased content 88% of review readers believe AI-generated reviews shouldn’t be allowed on review platforms Yelp Inc. February 5, 2025 Share This At Yelp, we understand the significant influence online reviews have on people’s purchasing decisions, which is why we take extensive measures to maintain reliable and helpful content on our platform, putting consumer trust at the center of everything we do. To further understand what makes online reviews helpful and trustworthy, we partnered with YouGov to survey over 2,350 review readers—individuals who’ve ever used online reviews of local businesses to guide their purchase decisions—uncovering valuable insights into consumer expectations and behaviors regarding local businesses and their reviews. The survey reveals that consumers value authenticity and quality in online reviews, preferring detailed, firsthand experiences over just star ratings. As reliance on reviews increases, people favor platforms that highlight genuine insights and prevent AI-generated, compensated, or incentivized reviews. Our commitment to these principles aligns with consumer expectations, helping us maintain trust and reliability in the review landscape. Consumers prefer detailed reviews from a variety of perspectives When making important spending decisions, whether for a special dining experience or hiring a professional for a kitchen remodel , people often rely on others’ recommendations. In fact, 72% of review readers say they read more online reviews now than ever before to guide their local business purchase decisions. Even as influencer reviews on social media become more prevalent, 88% of review readers still prefer seeing multiple opinions on review platforms over individual ones on social media. Aggregated feedback on review platforms often provides a more accurate and comprehensive prediction of what to expect from a local business, allowing people to more easily discover feedback on specific topics about a business that matter most to them. So what do consumers find most helpful when researching the right business? They value review text that reflects genuine, firsthand customer experiences—not simplistic rating systems. Indeed, 71% of review readers don’t consider a star rating without written text to be a review at all, and 88% are more likely to trust reviews with written text over just a star rating.  This underscores the importance of Yelp’s policy to require review text with every star rating. However, not all review platforms take the same approach, for instance, Google allows star ratings without text. Research from FTC Economist Devesh Raval found approximately 50% of Google reviews contain fewer than 100 characters, including 32% lacking text entirely. In contrast, the same research found that only 2% of Yelp reviews had less than 100 characters. As of December 31, 2024, the average length of recommended reviews contributed to Yelp was about 447 characters . Consumers seek more than just a star rating—they want detailed experiences and insights from customers, which is why our guidelines emphasize quality over quantity. Consumers want reviews written by actual customers—not AI Despite the rise of AI tools, 88% of review readers oppose AI-generated reviews on review platforms. This aligns with our policies at Yelp, as we require all reviews to be based on genuine, firsthand experiences with a business, and reviewers must write their own reviews. Since 2023, we’ve rolled out several new detection technologies powered by AI to help identify and mitigate AI-generated reviews, and we continue to enhance these efforts. Consumers don’t tolerate compensated and incentivized reviews Reviews sought in exchange for compensation or other incentives aim to mislead consumers. People strongly want review platforms to moderate these deceptive practices and disclose them when uncovered. The survey found that 91% of review readers want platforms to disclose if a business has ever been the subject of suspicious review activity or other attempts to deceive consumers. Additionally, 83% of review readers would avoid a business if they learned it had fake or compensated reviews. In September 2024, the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) issued a final rule banning fake and incentivized reviews. At Yelp, we not only align with this rule, but our policies go even further to address additional deceptive behaviors, such as prohibiting compensated and incentivized reviews altogether, attempts to suppress critical reviews , and more. For over a decade, our Consumer Alerts program has warned people when we find evidence of extreme attempts to manipulate ratings and reviews. Today, we’re introducing a Consumer Alerts History section on Yelp business pages that previously received Compensated Activity Alerts , Suspicious Review Activity Alerts , or Questionable Legal Threat Alerts . This new section, along with our existing index of Compensated and Suspicious Review Activity Alerts on our Trust & Safety site , ​​offers another way for people to learn about abnormal review activity or prior attempts to mislead them. Consumers want relevant reviews about customer experiences, not current events In an era marked by viral news and opinions spreading online at lightning speed, when a business gains public attention, we often see people flock to Yelp to share their opinions on the matter. However, such content can mislead other consumers and harm businesses, which is why it’s important to prevent and moderate reviews not based on genuine firsthand experiences with the business. In fact, 94% of review readers agree that reviews should reflect actual customer experiences, not what someone saw on the news or social media.  We address these incidents through our broader Consumer Alerts program . When our systems detect unusual spikes in activity, our User Operations team may investigate and, if necessary, temporarily disable the ability to post reviews while placing one of our Media Attention Alerts on the business’s Yelp page. Once activity decreases, we clean up the business page so that its reviews reflect firsthand consumer experiences. In 2024, 920 total Media Attention Alerts were placed on business pages , resulting in the removal of over 56,900 reviews. As the review landscape evolves, we remain committed to maintaining the integrity and quality of content on our platform. Our 2024 Trust & Safety Report , released today, offers a detailed look at how we safeguard our community of consumers and business owners by surfacing the most useful and reliable content on Yelp. Smarter hiring and smoother dining: Yelp’s AI-powered updates for services and restaurants | Yelp - Official Blog Skip to main content Toggle site navigation Yelp - Official Blog Blog News Businesses Community Life at Yelp Yelp.com Yelp for Business Search Yelp News Smarter hiring and smoother dining: Yelp’s AI-powered updates for services and restaurants From photo recognition and response quality badges to new tools for restaurants, we’re making it easier to hire pros and manage front-of-house operations Craig Saldanha Chief Product Officer April 29, 2025 Share This In this Spring Release we’re introducing: An even smarter Yelp Assistant with AI-powered photo recognition that automatically identifies and understands your project needs to connect you with the right pro . AI-powered response quality badges that spotlight service pros who consistently provide helpful and informative replies . A new lead management integration with Zapier , along with new measurement functionality for national services brands, helps pros seamlessly manage their leads. An improved dining experience with new tools, like Guest Experience Survey , helps restaurants better manage front-of-house operations and gives you more control over your visit . Our 2025 Spring Product Release marks the next step in our ongoing product transformation—one that’s grounded in using AI to deliver simplicity and efficiency in meeting your real-world needs. We’re doubling down on AI-powered innovation to enhance trust and ease decision-making, always with the same mission in mind: helping you connect with great local businesses. Today, we’re excited to introduce 15 new features and updates that simplify how you discover and hire pros, as well as enable restaurants to streamline their front-of-house operations. New AI-powered response quality badges and Yelp Assistant photo recognition will give you more confidence in choosing the right pro and help you seamlessly complete projects. We’re also releasing a suite of updates to help restaurants better manage their front-of-house operations and improve your diner experience—like automated Guest Experience Surveys and improved reservation management. From making it easier to complete service projects to enabling smarter restaurant operations, these updates make Yelp more intuitive, and more helpful. Representing the next step in Yelp’s AI transformation, we’ll soon begin testing AI-powered call answering services —one for restaurants and another for services—to help businesses stay connected when they’re busy or unavailable. Both call answering services will be fully integrated into Yelp’s platform with customizable features, and the ability to answer general questions, filter spam, transfer calls when needed, and capture messages. The solution for services will also collect details about your project and intelligently ask relevant questions to capture detailed leads for pros in their business owner account, while the restaurant solution will book reservations, add you to the waitlist, and seamlessly integrate into Yelp Guest Manager with access to call analytics. By grounding our AI in real consumer behavior and business data, we’re creating intuitive, transparent features that improve the experience for everyone on Yelp. Stay tuned for this exciting new development. Smarter AI-powered connections for hiring pros and enhancing lead management for national brands For years, Yelp has helped you hire service pros with confidence—whether you’re requesting pricing and availability with Request a Quote, getting coverage with Yelp Guaranteed , or using Yelp Assistant to find the right pro for the job. Today, we’re introducing more AI-powered features to help you find and hire reliable pros to seamlessly complete your projects. Now, you can snap a photo of your leaky faucet or broken appliance and Yelp Assistant will automatically identify your project needs and connect you with the right pro for the job. New AI-powered quality response badges will surface the pros who respond with the most helpful information. Plus, we’re expanding support for national services businesses with enhanced lead management solutions and a new integration with workflow automation platform Zapier. Enhancing Yelp Assistant with AI-powered photo recognition Since launching Yelp Assistant in 2024, we’ve continued to enhance it with new features and availability that make it easier to connect you with local pros. Now, Yelp Assistant uses AI-powered photo recognition to automatically identify and understand your project needs. Whether it’s an error code on your dishwasher, a dent in your car bumper, or a photo of your dream front yard makeover, there’s no need to type out long descriptions—just upload a photo related to your project and Yelp Assistant will pinpoint the service you’re looking for, ask relevant follow-up questions, and connect you with the right pros to complete your project. Yelp Assistant photo recognition helps pros receive more accurate project details, leading to better connections and more precise quotes—making hiring easier and more efficient than ever. Yelp Assistant photo recognition is currently available on iOS, with Android and desktop to come. Discover helpful service pros with AI-powered response insights Once you connect with a pro, receiving clear and detailed responses is critical to making informed decisions—no matter who you’re hiring. To address this need, we’re introducing AI-powered response quality badges to spotlight service pros who consistently provide helpful, informative replies to project requests. Now, you can find response quality badges, like “Excellent,” on eligible business pages and on business listings in Yelp search results—making it easier for you to identify pros with a reputation for reliable and thorough communication. AI-powered response quality badges spotlight service pros who consistently deliver helpful, informative replies to project requests. We’re leveraging large language models (LLMs) to evaluate response quality based on a variety of factors, including whether the business owner provides a quote or availability, acknowledges project details, asks relevant follow-up questions, and goes beyond a generic “call us” reply. Businesses need a minimum threshold of responses to generate a response quality score, which updates regularly based on recent replies. Business owners can view their score in their Yelp for Business profile and will find guided prompts when replying to new leads to help them improve their response quality. Response quality badges are currently displayed across all home, professional, local, auto, pets, event planning, real estate, and financial services categories on iOS and desktop in Arizona, Washington, Oregon, Illinois, and Indiana—with nationwide availability to come.  Bringing more lead management support to national services businesses Services brands with multiple locations often need a robust tech stack to manage their leads and customer communication. To simplify lead management, we’re integrating Yelp’s Leads API with Zapier , making it easier than ever to connect Yelp with your existing customer management system. For services brands looking for a quick-to-market solution, the Yelp Leads Zapier app automatically syncs and manages leads within their existing workflows. This no-code integration connects Yelp directly to over 800 CRM and lead management tools, helping businesses centralize their customer inquiry data and minimize manual effort.  SecureSpace , a nationwide self-storage brand owned by InSite, is among the first businesses to adopt Yelp’s Leads API with Zapier. According to Christian Espinal, marketing director at InSite, the impact has been transformative: Yelp’s new Zapier integration has been a major improvement for SecureSpace. It has significantly streamlined our lead management process, allowing our team to respond to potential customers more efficiently while reducing the internal coordination typically required for lead follow-up. We highly recommend this integration to any business looking to enhance their Request a Quote workflow. Now combined with Yelp’s Conversions API (CAPI), advertisers can more effectively measure and optimize their ads. For businesses that prefer their own in-house customer management, this powerful combination of the Leads API and CAPI enables services brands to manage leads across all their locations seamlessly within their existing lead management systems. Leads API with CAPI, and the Yelp Leads Zapier app are available now, with more CRM integrations planned soon. A smoother dining experience for restaurants and diners alike We’re introducing a suite of updates to Yelp Guest Manager designed to give restaurants deeper insights, streamline front-of-house operations, and make it easier than ever for diners to get a table and know exactly when and where they’ll be seated. These new features help hosts more effectively manage diner flow and communication—including a new Guest Experience Survey, redesigned party management experience, automated waitlist removal for unresponsive parties, improved shift management tools, guaranteed seating locations, and more. Guest Experience Survey captures comprehensive insights to inform business operations  Understanding the guest experience is essential for restaurants to improve service and drive repeat visits. The new Guest Experience Survey collects valuable feedback from diners through short, automated surveys. Daily results are easily accessible in a dedicated dashboard within the Business Owner Account, highlighting ratings across key aspects of the experience—such as food, drinks, service, and more—along with feedback on specific staff members and a net promoter score with optional guest comments. This aggregated feedback makes it easy to identify areas for improvement, spot trends from feedback, and implement changes to enhance the overall guest experience. This new tool can also integrate with POS systems to provide deeper operational insights. Guest Experience Survey helps restaurants gather diner feedback and identify trends to improve operations Lounge Group , a hospitality consulting firm, has already seen positive results from the Guest Experience Survey. As part of the pilot, Danielle Scribner, marketing director at Lounge Group, shared how the tool has made an impact across their locations: The Yelp Guest Experience Survey has made a huge difference in our restaurants. The feedback gives us real insight into what’s working and where we can improve—from service tweaks to menu updates. What we love most is that it’s not just about fixing problems; it’s also a great way to celebrate wins. When we get positive feedback, we share it with our team so they know their hard work is being noticed. It’s been a great tool for boosting morale and creating an even more positive work environment. It’s a simple but powerful tool, and we’re really seeing the impact. To support more effective feedback collection, we’re improving phone number collection so restaurants can send additional confirmation, survey, and reminder SMS messages. Guest Experience Survey is available as an add-on for Yelp Guest Manager Plus and Enterprise customers. AI-powered analytics will be available in the coming months to summarize feedback and surface key trends over time. Helping restaurants better manage reservations and staff Yelp Guest Manager customers now have access to an enhanced Traffic Attribution Dashboard in their Business Owner Account. This new dashboard breaks down covers by source, time, and day of the week—giving restaurants valuable insights into peak periods and their busiest days. Restaurants can also create custom booking links, allowing diners to make a reservation or join the waitlist directly from their preferred social media platforms. All traffic from these links is tracked in the dashboard, helping restaurants better understand where their guests are coming from. With these insights, restaurants can make more informed, data-driven decisions to optimize operations and maximize revenue. Restaurants can track valuable insights with the enhanced traffic attribution dashboard and custom booking links. A more seamless front-of-house experience We’re rolling out a series of updates to help restaurants streamline front-of-house operations and improve the guest experience—including a redesigned party management interface, automated Waitlist removal options, flexible shift scheduling capabilities, and more.  The redesigned party management experience makes it easier for hosts to seat guests efficiently and access important party information at a glance. It includes intuitive quick actions to update diner status, clearer icons and status indicators, and a simplified layout that highlights important details like party type, seating preferences, and visit notes. To improve waitlist accuracy and reduce manual work, we’re introducing automated rules that remove unresponsive parties—saving hosts time and helping to provide more accurate wait times for guests eager to be seated. We’re also making shift management more flexible than ever, helping restaurants better plan and adjust staffing needs. A new calendar view streamlines shift editing and removal, while the Copy Shift feature allows managers to easily duplicate past or active shifts. Additionally, in the coming weeks restaurants will be able to assign servers to multiple sections to better balance server utilization and staffing needs. Together, these enhancements make it easier for staff to manage the flow of guests and deliver a smoother, more efficient front-of-house experience. A redesigned party management experience helps staff manage guests more efficiently and streamline daily operations. Guaranteed seating areas: A win for hosts and diners With our new guaranteed seating areas feature, restaurants can now offer reservations for specific sections—like the bar, patio, or dining room—directly through Yelp. A new seating areas section in the floor plan editor within the Business Owner Account makes it easy to define and manage these areas based on demand, helping you better control table availability, optimize seating flow, and meet guest preferences more effectively. For diners, this means more transparency and control over their visit. Additionally, when joining a restaurant’s Yelp Waitlist, guests will now see a live progress bar on their iPhone lock screen, giving them real-time updates on their waitlist status—so they know exactly when and where they’ll be seated. Diners can reserve specific seating areas, giving them more control over their experience and helping restaurants manage seating flow. Whether you’re searching for a trusted pro, the perfect restaurant, or a new hair salon, these updates make it even easier for you to connect with great local businesses. We’re also giving you a faster, more secure way to log in using your device’s biometric capabilities by introducing passkeys on iOS, with Android support coming next month—eliminating the need for passwords or one-time codes. This is just the beginning of how we’re reimagining the experience across our platform through thoughtful, innovation-led product development. As we continue to roll out new advancements, we’re excited to bring more AI-driven solutions, like AI-powered call answering services that will help businesses stay even more connected and help you quickly get the support you need. International and bipartisan consensus against Google's illegal monopolies gains momentum | Yelp - Official Blog Skip to main content Toggle site navigation Yelp - Official Blog Blog News Businesses Community Life at Yelp Yelp.com Yelp for Business Search Yelp News International and bipartisan consensus against Google’s illegal monopolies gains momentum David Segal Vice President of Public Policy April 22, 2025 Share This One thing remains clear amid today’s political and economic uncertainty: a broad, cross-partisan movement to rein in Google is gaining momentum—both in the U.S. and around the world. A Bipartisan Legal Reckoning Last week marked a major milestone in the effort to hold Google accountable. Federal Judge Leonie Brinkema ruled that Google had illegally monopolized multiple markets in the advertising technology sector—a landmark decision that could lead to structural remedies. This week, Google returns to federal court in Washington, D.C. for the remedies trial in another major antitrust case prosecuted by the Department of Justice (DOJ) and state attorneys general. That trial—focused on Google’s illegal dominance in the general search market and overseen by Judge Amit Mehta—is part of one of the most consequential antitrust cases in decades and could result in the court ordering a breakup of parts of the company. Together, these cases underscore a growing legal consensus that unchecked platform dominance harms competition, innovation, and consumer choice. The DOJ’s general search and ad tech cases against Google illustrate rare continuity across presidential administrations. While the Biden Administration and former Assistant Attorney General (AAG) Jonathan Kanter carried the general search case forward, it was originally filed in 2020 under President Trump. Similarly, the ad tech case was filed in 2023 under President Biden and is now being pursued by the Trump Administration. This bipartisan and cross-administration commitment underscores the broad consensus on the need to address Google’s illegal conduct and unfair market dominance. And now, with AAG Gail Slater leading the DOJ’s Antitrust Division under the Trump Administration, the government is pushing for bold remedies. These include, among other measures , the divestiture of Google’s Chrome browser—which Google has used to illegally entrench its general search monopoly—as well as a ban on default search engine payments, restrictions on self-preferencing of Google’s general search service, and improved third-party access to Google’s search index. Policymakers Support Enforcement and Push for Bold Legislative Solutions As the DOJ and state Attorneys General press forward in court, Congress is signaling its readiness to act. The Senate Judiciary Committee’s Antitrust Subcommittee recently held its first hearing of 2025, titled “ Big Fixes for Big Tech .” Chaired by longtime Google critic Sen. Mike Lee (R-UT), the hearing explored legislative and judicial solutions to curb Google’s dominance in general search and advertising. Panelists from companies like DuckDuckGo, Y Combinator, and Digital Content Next proposed reforms—and received bipartisan support from senators in attendance.   One notable voice was freshman Sen. Ashley Moody (R-FL), a former Florida Attorney General who previously sued Google over the company’s ad and search monopolies. Speaking of Big Tech, Moody noted “We’ve gobbled up the Ad tech markets, gobbled up little tech companies that were emerging and sometimes stifling innovation there, we’ve gobbled markets.” Since enforcement by the courts can be slow, she emphasized the need for proactive legislation–so-called “ex ante” rules to prevent monopolistic behavior before it occurs. Her remarks reflect a continuing appetite in Congress for bold legislative action to restore competition in digital markets. That consensus was also on display at a recent bipartisan event in Washington, D.C., hosted by Y Combinator and organized in part by Luther Lowe, my predecessor at Yelp. The event brought together top antitrust enforcers from both the Trump and Biden administrations — including former FTC Chair Lina Khan, former AAG Jonathan Kanter, Acting AAG Doha Mekki, FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson, and AAG Gail Slater. Despite their political differences, all emphasized the need for continued, consistent enforcement against Big Tech monopolies. International Regulators Fight for Fair Competition The global momentum is just as strong. At the same D.C. event, European Commission Executive Vice President Teresa Ribera, who helms the EC’s antitrust enforcement arm, discussed the EC’s recent preliminary finding that Google violated the Digital Markets Act’s (DMA) prohibition on self-preferencing, including in the local search space. Yelp has been in regular conversation with the EC about these matters, and is supportive of this landmark finding. In March, Yelp joined a letter from scores of tech companies to the Trump administration underscoring the importance of the DMA, and pushing back against Big Tech’s misleading claims that the DMA discriminates against American firms. The EC’s action signals that the global regulatory tide is continuing its turn against platform self-dealing and toward a more level playing field for digital competitors. Meanwhile, the United Kingdom (UK) is also stepping up. In January, the UK’s Competition and Markets Authority launched its first investigation under the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act, examining whether Google has so-called “Strategic Market Status” in the general search, a designation that could trigger new obligations and oversight. These developments reflect a growing global consensus: unchecked tech monopolies are a threat to innovation, competition, and consumer choice. Whether through litigation, legislation, or regulatory enforcement, the tide is turning. At Yelp, we look forward to continuing our work with lawmakers and enforcers in the U.S. and abroad to ensure that antitrust laws are enforced—and that consumers and small businesses alike can thrive in a truly competitive digital marketplace. We’ve swapped flip phones for smart phones, Mean Girls is now a musical, and we’ve devoured era-defining food trends, from cronuts, to caviar bumps. Despite all the changes, one thing that hasn’t changed is our commitment to helping people discover great businesses in their community. As we approach Yelp’s 20th anniversary, we’re shining an extra bright spotlight on some of our most beloved businesses and revealing two new lists: the top 20 most photographed businesses and top 20 most popular businesses of all time. From classic favorites to lavish eats, these lists feature the crème de la crème of top businesses that have kept Yelpers coming back throughout the past two decades. Number one on the most photographed businesses of all-time list is Disneyland in Anaheim, California, with more than 49,000 photos of users sharing their experiences with the park’s cast of characters, themed dishes and attractions. Following Disneyland are two Las Vegas hotspots known for their camera-worthy dishes, including Bacchanal Buffet (no. 2) and Gordon Ramsay Hell’s Kitchen (no. 3), which also ranked in the top five of this year’s Most Photographed Restaurants 2024. 20 Discover Top 20 Most Photographed Businesses of All Time 1660 Followers Last Updated 9/17/2024 Top 20 Most Photographed Businesses of All Time From top-rated attractions with magical atmospheres to must-visit dining experiences with exceptional cuisines, Yelp’s Most Photographed Businesses commemorates our 20th anniversary, and highlights the most photo-worthy spots across the US of the last 20 years. Methodology: This is a list of the most photographed businesses in the US of all time, according to Yelp. To determine this list, we ranked businesses based on how frequently distinct users submitted photos. Yelp 1 0 Follow Collection 20 Places (Sorted by Ranking) • 1 Disneyland Park 11970 reviews $$$ Amusement Parks Anaheim, CA Disneyland Park in Anaheim is a beloved destination for families and thrill-seekers alike, often praised for its magical atmosphere and impeccable attention to detail. Yelp users often highlight the nostalgic charm that keeps them coming back year after year. • 2 Bacchanal Buffet 16295 reviews $$$$ Buffets Las Vegas, NV Bacchanal Buffet in Las Vegas is a hit among Yelp users for its incredible variety of high-quality dishes and luxurious dining experience. Reviewers rave about the fresh seafood, succulent meats, and decadent desserts, making it a must-visit for anyone dining on the Las Vegas Strip. • 3 Gordon Ramsay Hell’s Kitchen 12958 reviews $$$$ New American , Seafood Las Vegas, NV Gordon Ramsay Hell's Kitchen in Las Vegas draws crowds with its exquisite cuisine and immersive atmosphere that mirrors the famous TV show. Yelp users often snap photos of the perfectly cooked Beef Wellington and exceptional cocktails. • 4 Bestia 8114 reviews $$$ Italian , Cocktail Bars Los Angeles, CA Bestia in Los Angeles is a favorite spot for both casual and special occasions. Yelp reviewers love to take photos of innovative Italian dishes, including the handmade pastas and creative charcuterie boards, often describing the food as bursting with flavor. • 5 Universal Studios Hollywood 6166 reviews $$$$ Amusement Parks Universal City, CA Universal Studios Hollywood is a favorite for its exciting rides and immersive movie-themed attractions. Visitors often highlight the Studio Tour in reviews and love sharing photos of the Wizarding World of Harry Potter (more than 4,100 photos and counting!) • 6 San Diego Zoo 6002 reviews $$$ Zoos San Diego, CA San Diego Zoo is renowned for its incredible variety of animals and beautifully landscaped grounds, making it a top destination for families and animal lovers alike. • 7 The Metropolitan Museum of Art 3645 reviews $ Art Museums New York, NY The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York captivates visitors with its vast and diverse collection and stunning architecture. Users appreciate the world-class exhibits and rich history that the museum offers. • 8 Mama’s Fish House 9818 reviews $$$$ Seafood , Hawaiian Paia, HI Mama's Fish House in Paia is celebrated for its fresh, locally-sourced seafood, picturesque oceanfront setting and romantic ambiance. Yelp reviewers rave about the flavors and service, making it a must-dine for food enthusiasts. • 9 Marugame Udon 13757 reviews $$ Japanese , Noodles Honolulu, HI Marugame Udon in Honolulu is a hit for its freshly-made udon at an affordable price point. Yelp users love the quick service and often mention the customizable menu options as a highlight. • 10 Republique 7619 reviews $$ French , Breakfast & Brunch Los Angeles, CA République in Los Angeles is adored for its innovative French-inspired cuisine, housed in a stunning, historic building. Users love to snap photos of delicious pastries, like the Brioche French Toast, and creative dishes, like the Kimchi Fried Rice. With more than 3,500 reviews and 22,000 photos, it’s no surprise this New York institution is a must-visit for many Yelp users.  Rounding out the top three most popular businesses on Yelp are Balboa Park in San Diego, known by Yelpers for its expansive gardens and family-friendly events, and The Getty Center in Los Angeles, which features an impressive art collection and stunning views. Yelp releases a series of new discovery, contribution, services and AI-powered features | Yelp - Official Blog Skip to main content Toggle site navigation Yelp - Official Blog Blog News Businesses Community Life at Yelp Yelp.com Yelp for Business Search Yelp News Yelp releases a series of new discovery, contribution, services and AI-powered features New updates enhance connections between consumers and local businesses Craig Saldanha Chief Product Officer January 30, 2024 Share This Yelp is introducing more than 20 new updates that enhance the Yelp experience for our community of consumers and business owners, including: AI-powered business summaries that make it even easier to find a business that fits your needs with a quick glance. Recognitions that celebrate and distinguish reviewers who are passionate about a specific food, cuisine or nightlife category. A new visual home feed and search experience enhance discovery, helping you quickly and easily find your new favorite restaurant. New updates to the services experience, such as enhancements to Request a Quote and new ‘Projects’ features, make it easier to find the right service professional for your needs, as well as quickly and efficiently get your projects done.  A revamped business owner experience that delivers valuable market and competitive insights, while AI-powered smart budgets provide useful recommendations to optimize ad spend, helping local businesses grow and better compete in their markets. Reflecting back on 2023, we released more than 35 new features that bring more value to all of our users – from leveraging large language models (LLMs ) and other updates that ease decision making, to new features that help you hire a service pro with confidence, enhancements to the reviewing experience , and more. Meanwhile, for business owners we leveraged AI to make setting up their ads easier and more cost effective. And, for restaurant owners, we integrated with third parties to give our Yelp Guest Manager clients access to the largest restaurant consumer network in the U.S. Now, as we kick off the new year, we’re excited to share our new Winter Release full of features that make life even easier.  Today, we’re announcing more than 20 new features and updates across the Yelp platform that make it more seamless and engaging for users to discover and connect with great local businesses in their community. New AI-powered business summaries surface short, unique insights that detail what you can expect at a business; and fun, new Recognitions celebrate your helpful reviews. You’ll also find a more visual and engaging home feed and search experience that brings local businesses to life, new features that make it easier than ever to connect and coordinate with service professionals that meet your exact needs, and more. For business owners, we’re introducing new updates that help them operate more efficiently, better compete in their local markets, and grow their business.  Easing decision making with AI-powered business summaries that surface unique insights For years, we’ve leveraged AI to help reduce consumers’ decision paralysis — from spotlighting the most popular dishes and drinks , to using LLMs to power review highlights for more nuanced searches.  Now, new AI-powered business summaries leverage LLMs to parse recent reviews and describe what you can expect at the business, helping you quickly find a business that fits your needs at a glance. At the top of restaurant, food and nightlife business pages, these unique summaries highlight what the business is best known for based on first-hand reviews from users — such as the atmosphere, service, amenities, value, or a popular dish. AI-powered business summaries are available on iOS and will roll out to Android and desktop later this year.  Celebrating and supporting contributors with an enhanced review experience You deserve to be celebrated for taking the time to write reviews that help others in your community make informed spending decisions, which is why we’re rolling out new features that spotlight regular contributors, as well as expanding our interactive review topics to make it even easier to write rich and detailed reviews. Recognitions celebrate your helpful contributions We’re rolling out a new way for you to earn Recognitions for writing reviews in the categories you’re most passionate about. Today, you can earn more than 165 Recognitions across a variety of foods, cuisines and nightlife spots , including brunch, burgers, cocktails, coffee, ice cream, ramen, tacos, and more. Recognitions are earned for writing at least three reviews within a year for businesses within the same select category and are featured in the ‘Achievements’ section on the ‘Me Tab’ in the Yelp iOS app. In the coming months, Recognitions will also appear next to your reviews on business pages for the same category to further distinguish the contributors who are familiar with reviewing a particular type of restaurant, food or nightlife business . Recognitions for additional categories and platforms will roll out later this year. More review topics make writing helpful reviews even easier To further alleviate writer’s block when drafting a review, we’re expanding our interactive review topics to new categories across home, local, professional and auto services, as well as beauty, shopping, health and medical. Review topics identify when common themes are covered in reviews — like the “care quality” at a doctor’s office or when someone writes about the “value” of a service provided from a contractor — to remind you of helpful details of your experience that other people would want to know about. Review writing has never been more engaging with new Recognitions and interactive review topics in more categories. Revamping the discovery experience to make it more visual than ever before We know that the hundreds of millions of photos and videos on Yelp play an important role in helping you decide what business is right for you. Visual elements provide important insights on a business’s ambiance, services offered, or the food quality, which is why we’re rolling out new features and updates that spotlight high-quality visual content, to help you quickly and easily find great local businesses. New AI-powered home feed highlights more relevant and visual content to users We’re introducing a new home feed experience on iOS that leverages AI to surface the most relevant photos from Yelp users and content from nearby businesses, encouraging the discovery of businesses near you. In addition to relevant user photos, you can expect to see autoplay video updates from restaurant, food, and nightlife businesses via Yelp Connect posts, as well as Collections from Yelp Elites . In the coming months, the homepage will also feature user videos and roll out on Android. Revamped visual search experience brings business listings to life We’ve updated the entire iOS search experience with more visual components to help you easily find the right business for your needs. From the start, you’ll find a new suggestions page that highlights popular and recent searches before you’ve even begun typing — helping you get started when you aren’t quite sure what you’re looking for or when you want to quickly pick up where you left off from a previous search.  Search results for restaurants, food and nightlife businesses will now feature photo-heavy search results listings, visually bringing businesses to life. For frequently searched foods, you’ll find new carousels that highlight popular dishes, such as pizza, ramen, sandwiches and tacos, saving you time when you want to find if a business near you offers the dish you’re craving.  If you still can’t settle on the right business, the new “People also search for” component in search results helps narrow down your choices with search recommendations for fine dining, hottest restaurants, restaurants with views, local favorites, and more. We’re also bringing the Surprise Me feature to Android users, which recommends nearby restaurants to consumers looking for ideas on deciding where to eat. Look out for even more updates to the search experience soon, like eye-catching videos, as well as this revamped search experience on Android later this year. With more immersive visual content, the Yelp home feed and enhanced search results will help consumers discover their new favorite restaurants. Streamlining the services experience and connecting people with pros faster When you’re looking to start a new home project or find a helpful local service, it can sometimes be hard to know where to start, which is why we’ve been focused on making it easier and more seamless to confidently find the right pro for the job. Today’s updates further alleviate this process with a more streamlined Request a Quote experience; new ‘Projects’ features that help you quickly and conveniently coordinate with pros; and the expansion of Yelp Guaranteed , which gives you confidence that the job will be done right. With millions of projects started on Yelp every year, these features, and more, are also helping business owners close leads faster and better reach consumers looking to hire pros. Enhanced ‘Projects’ helps you seamlessly coordinate with service pros We added a range of new features and functionalities to the ‘Projects’ experience, including the ability to upload video and provide documentation for project requests, and archive old projects. Our new quick replies make it effortless to respond to a business with easy one-click responses that explain your project needs. You can also now opt-in to receive SMS notifications and messages directly from businesses to coordinate with pros and get your projects finished without having to open the Yelp app or log into your account. Improved Request a Quote experience connects you with pros faster We’re streamlining the Request a Quote experience with updated questions based on the business’s unique services, facilitating more efficient communication with businesses after submitting a quote request. We’re also speeding up the process to request a quote by pre-filling and skipping questions based on your search. These improvements are making it easier for you to connect with the right business for your project, and in turn driving more engaged leads to pros. Yelp Guaranteed helps more people hire with confidence Yelp Guaranteed , our satisfaction guarantee program that allows customers to get up to $2,500 back in the event something goes wrong with their project, is now available nationwide. We’re also surfacing new ways for you to see which services businesses are backed by Yelp – in addition to filtering for Yelp Guaranteed businesses, you can now find the Yelp Guaranteed badge alongside eligible businesses when scrolling through business listings in search results. Phone leads help service pros close more leads To make it easier to book a job or schedule an appointment, businesses with Request a Quote enabled can now directly call or text potential customers that opt-into being contacted directly by the business. To protect user privacy, businesses receive a masked temporary phone number and users can opt-out at any time. Hiring a service pro has never been easier with new updates to the ‘Projects’ and Request a Quote experiences, as well as the nationwide availability of Yelp Guaranteed. New phone leads make it easier for business owners to coordinate directly with customers and close more leads. Enhancing the Business Owner Experience with AI and data-driven Insights In a highly competitive market, local businesses are constantly seeking new ways to stand out. Our latest product enhancements provide even more valuable insights to businesses on Yelp, equipping business owners with comprehensive competitive performance data and smarter ad budget recommendations , helping them make strategic, informed decisions to reach relevant consumers and grow their business. New data-driven Yelp for Business homepage enables business owners to make more informed decisions We’re introducing a new data-driven Yelp for Business homepage that shares enhanced performance, customer and competitor insights. The updated performance summary highlights a snapshot of a business’s success on Yelp, such as the number of impressions, pageviews, and leads a business has received. Customer insights detail audience data like what neighborhoods have the most consumers searching for the services they offer and the trending search terms in their area. New competitor insights provide performance comparisons detailing page visits over time compared to similar businesses, and the names of highly-viewed competitors. Enhanced onboarding experience with AI-driven insights sets you up for success We revamped the experience for new advertisers on Yelp, helping them better determine the right ad budget for their business , as well as easily improve their business page. AI-powered smart budgets, now leveraging neural networks , provide helpful advertising budget recommendations to businesses by taking into account numerous unique factors about their business — including their rating, category, listing age, region, and more — to help them select the advertising option with the highest potential ROI. In addition, the new “Getting Started” section helps bu sinesses set up their page for success with recommendations based on a predictive analysis of what will drive the most success, and the redesigned business Q&A section helps them quickly respond to public questions from consumers. Scheduled consultations provide more support for advertisers We’re introducing a new support option for advertisers to seamlessly get in touch with Yelp’s customer service team with scheduled consultations. Now, businesses can get instant support from Yelp when it’s most convenient for them, without needing to hold for a representative. The revamped Yelp for Business experience surfaces more insights and recommendations for business owners and advertisers. Scheduled consultations enable advertisers to reach Yelp support when it’s most convenient for them. To seamlessly access all these new features and more, we’re also rolling out an easy one-time login experience that allows you to simply enter a pin to access your account, including your ‘Projects’ messages.  This year, as Yelp celebrates two decades of connecting you with great local businesses, we’re committed to building new features across the platform to better inform your spending decisions, as well as deliver more value to local businesses. We’re continuing to double down on new product updates that harness our rich, trusted content to elevate moments of discovery and inspire even more meaningful connections. With recent advancements in AI, you can expect to see us further leverage LLMs to ease the discovery experience, facilitate more seamless connections with service providers and help local businesses succeed. We can’t wait to share more on what we’ve been building. Yelp enhances consumer experience with new discovery, review and services features | Yelp - Official Blog Skip to main content Toggle site navigation Yelp - Official Blog Blog News Businesses Community Life at Yelp Yelp.com Yelp for Business Search Yelp News Yelp enhances consumer experience with new discovery, review and services features New updates include Yelp Guaranteed, an AI-powered search experience, a revamped reviewing experience with video in reviews and more Craig Saldanha Chief Product Officer April 25, 2023 Share This Yelp is introducing a series of new features to enhance the consumer experience in our most significant update in recent years: Yelp Guaranteed, a new satisfaction guarantee that offers our Request a Quote users peace of mind when hiring home service professionals. An enhanced search experience that leverages Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to help people connect and discover the right business for their needs. Immersive video, interactive topics and new reactions in reviews make Yelp contributions even more engaging. For nearly 20 years, Yelp has served as a community-driven platform that empowers you to discover and confidently connect with local businesses. We’re always working to enhance this experience by building products and features that give you access to reliable and useful information, helping you decide where to spend your money and share your experiences with your local community.  Today, we’re excited to unveil a number of new features that make it even easier for you to discover businesses that fit your needs and contribute helpful content on Yelp. A new satisfaction guarantee program, Yelp Guaranteed, will help you hire home service professionals with greater confidence. An AI-powered search experience helps match you with the most relevant local businesses when you have a specific or nuanced need, and new discovery features help you find the right business when you’re not sure what you’re looking for. To make reviews more visual and interactive, you will now be able to add video to reviews, write richer, more helpful reviews with greater ease and react to reviews in new ways. Plus, we’re introducing more visual updates across the platform to help you better discover and connect with great local businesses within your community. Yelp Guaranteed makes hiring home service pros a worry-free experience When looking to hire a professional for a home project, it’s easy to feel inundated with choices — comparing ratings, reviews, availability and pricing before settling on the right business. To provide you with greater confidence and peace of mind during the hiring process, we’re rolling out Yelp Guaranteed , a new satisfaction guarantee program that will allow you to get up to $2,500 back in the event something goes wrong with your project. When you hire a business through Yelp’s Request a Quote feature for an eligible project, you’ll automatically be enrolled in the program, allowing you to submit a claim if you run into challenges resolving an issue directly with the business — either because you’re not satisfied with the work performed, property was damaged related to the project or if the business was a no-show on a pre-paid job. Yelp Guaranteed is currently available for eligible projects submitted through Request a Quote based on a variety of qualification factors. You can now use a Yelp Guaranteed search filter to find businesses where your project will be covered. You’ll also find “Covered by Yelp Guaranteed” below the Request a Quote feature on business pages, when the project is eligible. Today, Yelp Guaranteed is available across the U.S. for popular home service categories on Yelp. You can easily discover businesses where your project will be covered by Yelp Guaranteed by selecting the “Yelp Guaranteed” filter in search, as well as looking out for the Yelp Guaranteed badge surfaced on business pages and in your ’Projects’ tab . Enhancing the search experience on Yelp leveraging LLMs and AI With the vast amount of rich user-generated content available on Yelp, we’ve long used AI to power solutions across our platform, including dish recommendations , organization of photos and automating content moderation , among others. With the recent advancements in LLMs, we’re continuing to invest in further enhancing the search and discovery experience on Yelp to make it even easier for you to find businesses that fit your needs. We’re announcing a number of the new search features today, which build on our investment in AI and LLMs to surface smarter search suggestions and power insights to help you find the right business. By leveraging these technologies to analyze the vast amounts of our user-generated content, in the future we’ll be able to quickly, precisely and succinctly summarize insights and provide personalized recommendations based on your search intent. Review highlights driven by LLMs make finding relevant businesses easier By leveraging LLMs, Yelp can better understand the nuance in your search intent and highlight relevant information from reviews in new snippets that appear under each business listing in your search results. For example, when you search for “ tennis courts ” on Yelp, in addition to the list of parks and sports facilities that appear in your search results, you will also now see helpful review highlights about tennis courts under each park or facility listed, such as “there are tennis courts that you need to book in advance.” AI-powered search suggestions help you easily find businesses anywhere We’re using AI to provide better search suggestions based on your search intent that are not bound by your location – helping you make plans for the future when you’re not looking for businesses near home, or go back to review a business you visited on a recent trip. Yelp now suggests businesses that you may be looking for across the U.S., streamlining the discovery experience for when you already have a specific business in mind. “Surprise Me” provides inspiration for where to eat When you’re having a tough time deciding where to eat, Yelp’s new Surprise Me feature combats analysis paralysis with restaurant selection. An easy click on the red “Surprise me” button, found on the Yelp home feed and search results, will generate a unique highly-rated recommendation near you. If the first recommendation isn’t for you, hit “Surprise me again” for a new suggestion. More than one million businesses have already been suggested every month through this new feature. Clickable category tags enhance discovery in search If you’re still not sure where to eat, clickable category tags on business listings for restaurants, food and nightlife searches, help you better refine your search and connect with the right business. Yelp is using LLMs to enhance the search results with review highlights, as well as making it easier for you to narrow down your search with new clickable category tags and Surprise Me. Revamping the review experience with new ways to contribute We’re introducing new visual and interactive ways for you to share your experiences with businesses, as well as new ways for you to engage with and react to reviews. Videos in reviews Videos are a great way to capture and share your experiences — whether it’s of a steaming bowl of ramen, a new hike you discovered in your local park, or the view from a recent hotel stay. To provide a unique inside look into your experience with the business, you’ll be able post high-resolution video up to 12 seconds alongside your text review and photos. Review topics make writing helpful reviews even easier We know that sometimes you may develop writer’s block when crafting reviews. To remind you what made your experience great when reviewing restaurant, food and nightlife businesses, we’re rolling out new interactive review topics – “food,” “service” and “ambiance” – that help you track what you’ve covered, and remind you of other topics you might want to address. Once a topic is addressed it will automatically turn green with a checkmark at the top of your draft review. In the coming months, we plan to expand relevant review topics to even more categories, such as services, beauty, health and shopping.  New review reactions For many of you in our community, the “Useful,” “Funny” and “Cool” review reactions have become synonymous with Yelp over the past 15 years. The time has come to introduce more expressive ways to appreciate Yelpers for their reviews with new “Helpful,” “Thanks,” “Love this” and “Oh no” reactions. We’ve already seen over six times more reactions to reviews with these new expressive reactions. To make sure you aren’t losing any of the previous engagement with your reviews, “Useful” reactions will now count towards “Helpful,” and “Funny” or “Cool” reactions will count towards “Love this.” Yelp has revamped the review writing experience with interactive review topics and the ability to upload videos to your reviews. Yelp has also introduced four new review reactions. Introducing more visual and seamless experiences across the platform We’re rolling out new features that better surface our rich, visual content and make it even easier to find the business information you’re looking for. These changes across the platform will help you make informed spending decisions that you can trust. Bringing video to Connect Yelp Connect is a paid feature that allows business owners to share important updates directly with consumers. We’re now empowering businesses to upload videos to their Connect posts, giving you more engaging content from the business — from a weekly deal, to special menu items, to upcoming events and more. New navigation and photo experience on business pages makes it easier to find what you’re looking for A new navigation bar on restaurant, food and nightlife business pages makes it easy for you to more efficiently find the information you’re looking for by jumping directly to a business’s menu, amenities, reviews, or other helpful information. We’ve also redesigned the photo viewing experience on business pages by introducing AI-driven photo categories for food and nightlife businesses, as well as a new sort feature that enables people to quickly see recently added photos. These updates allow you to easily find photos based on what you’re most interested in – such as the most recent menu photo and the different types of cuisines or dishes a restaurant has to offer. Relatedly, we’ve updated the look and feel of business photos on desktop with a new infinite vertical scrolling feature so you can easily view all the photos for a business. Surfacing more helpful information on the visual home feed The refreshed home feed now surfaces even more helpful information about local businesses near you, including the total review count of a business, how many other reviewers mentioned a Popular Dish in a positive review, the price of a menu item, your distance from a business and more. We plan to bring even more helpful information and visual contributions, including video, to the home feed this year. Passwordless login We’re rolling out a new login experience that won’t require you to remember your password every time you want to log into your account. Now, when you’re logging into Yelp, you will receive a unique email link that seamlessly and securely authenticates with just one click. This allows you to automatically sign in to submit your requests for quotes, create Collections , join a waitlist and more. Yelp has rolled out a variety of new features and visual updates that improve the user experience. These product updates demonstrate our significant investment in innovating and enhancing the consumer experience, so people can easily and confidently connect with great local businesses. Now and into the future, we’re focused on building solutions that better identify your nuanced needs, help you unquestionably hire service professionals and further instill trust in the information you find on Yelp. In the coming months, we will continue to build upon these new features, expand them to even more users and further leverage advanced technology, such as AI and LLMs, to enhance our platform. We look forward to sharing more on what’s to come soon. Additional assets and images from the announcement can be found here .
